blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: NIST-Traceable Standard（NIST 可追溯標準）：美國國家標準與技術研究院（NIST）認證的聚苯乙烯乳膠球，具有已知且可追溯的粒徑。USP 要求使用 100、250、400 nm 三個尺寸標準，覆蓋脂肪乳劑正常粒徑範圍，確保儀器校正在分析前已通過驗證。
blocks.en: NIST-Traceable Standard: Polystyrene latex spheres certified by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), with a known and traceable particle size. USP requires standards of three sizes, 100, 250 and 400 nm, covering the normal size range of fat emulsions, to ensure the instrument calibration is verified before analysis.

blocks.zh: Intensity-Weighted Mean Diameter（強度加權平均粒徑）：DLS 報告的粒徑是以散射光強度為權重計算的平均值，而非數量加權。由於大粒子的散射強度遠大於小粒子，強度加權均值通常大於數量加權均值——使用者必須清楚報告的是哪種加權方式。
blocks.en: Intensity-Weighted Mean Diameter: The size reported by DLS is a mean weighted by scattered light intensity, not by number. Because large particles scatter far more light than small ones, the intensity-weighted mean is usually larger than the number-weighted mean, so users must be clear about which weighting is being reported.

blocks.zh: Chi-Square (χ²) Goodness-of-Fit（卡方適合度）：DLS 儀器用來評估測量數據與假設的粒徑分佈模型（通常為對數常態分佈）的吻合程度。χ² 過高代表乳劑粒徑分佈異常，可能是乳化不穩定或已發生破乳（coalescence）的訊號。
blocks.en: Chi-Square (χ²) Goodness-of-Fit: The DLS instrument uses this to assess how well the measured data match the assumed particle size distribution model (usually a lognormal distribution). A high χ² indicates an abnormal size distribution and may be a sign of emulsion instability or coalescence.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: MDD < 500 nm 是硬性標準，不依賴油脂濃度：無論乳劑中脂肪含量是 10%、20% 還是 30%，平均粒徑都必須小於 500 nm。這是 USP 〈729〉 Method I 的單一核心接受標準。
blocks.en: MDD < 500 nm is a hard criterion, independent of oil concentration: Whether the emulsion contains 10%, 20% or 30% fat, the mean droplet diameter must be below 500 nm. This is the single core acceptance criterion of USP <729> Method I.

blocks.zh: CV ≤ 15% 的系統適用性：這個 15% 的限度比一般分析方法寬鬆，是因為 DLS 與 LD（Laser Diffraction）計算均值的方式不同——USP 特別在附注中說明了這一點。如果 CV 超標，不能進行樣品分析，必須更換標準品並重新評估。
blocks.en: System suitability of CV ≤ 15%: This 15% limit is looser than for typical analytical methods because DLS and LD (laser diffraction) calculate the mean differently, a point USP explains specifically in a note. If the CV is exceeded, sample analysis must not proceed; the standard must be replaced and the situation re-evaluated.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: System Suitability 就像每天開車前先確認煞車功能正常。你不會直接上路就踩煞車測試——你先在停車場低速確認系統運作正常，才敢上高速公路。DLS 的系統適用性（用 NIST 標準品確認儀器讀值準確）就是這道「上路前的煞車測試」，通過了才能分析真實樣品。
blocks.en: System suitability is like checking that the brakes work before driving each day. You would not test the brakes by stomping on them on the open road; you first confirm at low speed in the parking lot that the system works, and only then dare to take the highway. DLS system suitability (using NIST standards to confirm the instrument reads accurately) is this "brake test before hitting the road", and only after it passes can real samples be analyzed.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果某批脂肪乳劑的 MDD = 480 nm，但 χ² 值明顯偏高，您作為品質主管應如何決策？光是 MDD < 500 nm 是否足以放行？
blocks.en: If a batch of fat emulsion has an MDD of 480 nm but a clearly elevated χ² value, how should you, as quality head, decide? Is MDD < 500 nm alone sufficient for release?

blocks.zh: 系統適用性 CV ≤ 15% 的要求為何比一般 CV ≤ 2% 的分析方法寬鬆得多？這說明 DLS 作為定量工具的哪些局限性？
blocks.en: Why is the system suitability requirement of CV ≤ 15% so much looser than the CV ≤ 2% of typical analytical methods? What does this say about the limitations of DLS as a quantitative tool?

blocks.zh: Method II — Light Obscuration (LE/SPOS) | 光遮蔽法 / 單粒子光學定粒法
blocks.en: Method II: Light Obscuration (LE/SPOS)

blocks.zh: Light Obscuration / Light Extinction (LE)（光遮蔽法/光消光法）：粒子通過細光束時，遮擋部分光線，導致偵測器接收到的光強度瞬間下降。脈衝高度（voltage pulse height）與粒子截面積（即粒徑平方）成正比。與 〈788〉 中用於注射劑微粒監控的技術是同一原理。
blocks.en: Light Obscuration / Light Extinction (LE): When a particle passes through a narrow light beam, it blocks part of the light, causing an instantaneous drop in the light intensity received by the detector. The voltage pulse height is proportional to the particle cross-sectional area (that is, the square of the diameter). This is the same principle as the technique used for particulate monitoring of injectables in <788>.

blocks.zh: Single-Particle Optical Sizing (SPOS)（單粒子光學定粒法）：一次只讓一個粒子通過感測區（sensing zone），確保每個脈衝信號對應一個粒子，實現精確計數與定粒。這是 LE 方法能夠可靠計算 PFAT5 的關鍵——它是一個真正的「計數」方法。
blocks.en: Single-Particle Optical Sizing (SPOS): Only one particle at a time is allowed through the sensing zone, so that each pulse signal corresponds to one particle, enabling accurate counting and sizing. This is what allows the LE method to calculate PFAT5 reliably: it is a true "counting" method.

blocks.zh: Coincidence Limit（符合限值）：當粒子濃度過高時，兩個粒子可能同時通過感測區，被誤計為一個大粒子，造成「重合誤差」（coincidence error）。必須通過適當稀釋確保濃度低於此限值（符合事件 <1%）。
blocks.en: Coincidence Limit: When the particle concentration is too high, two particles may pass through the sensing zone at the same time and be miscounted as one large particle, causing "coincidence error". The sample must be diluted appropriately so that the concentration stays below this limit (coincidence events <1%).

blocks.zh: LE/SPOS 就像收費站的電子感應系統（ETC）：每輛車（每個粒子）依序通過感測區，系統記錄每輛車的「大小」（脈衝高度）並計數。如果同時來了兩輛摩托車，系統可能誤判為一輛轎車——這就是「符合誤差」。因此稀釋樣品的目的不只是讓儀器可以量測，更是確保粒子排隊一個一個通過，計數準確。
blocks.en: LE/SPOS is like the electronic toll collection (ETC) system at a toll station: each vehicle (each particle) passes through the sensing zone in turn, and the system records each vehicle's "size" (pulse height) and counts it. If two motorcycles arrive at the same time, the system may mistake them for one sedan; this is "coincidence error". The purpose of diluting the sample is therefore not only to make it measurable, but to make sure the particles pass through one by one in a queue so that counting is accurate.

blocks.zh: LE 標準品選用 5 µm 和 10 µm（非 DLS 的 100/250/400 nm）：這清楚說明兩種方法覆蓋截然不同的粒徑範圍。Method I 驗證儀器在奈米尺度（<500 nm）的準確性，Method II 驗證儀器在微米尺度（>5 µm）的準確性。
blocks.en: LE standards of 5 µm and 10 µm (not the 100/250/400 nm used for DLS): This makes clear that the two methods cover very different size ranges. Method I verifies instrument accuracy at the nanometer scale (<500 nm), and Method II verifies instrument accuracy at the micrometer scale (>5 µm).

blocks.zh: 偵測範圍設定：下限 1.8 µm，上限 50 µm：下限 1.8 µm 比目標閾值 5 µm 更低，是為了確保 5 µm 附近的粒子也能被可靠偵測；上限 50 µm 則覆蓋臨床上可能有害的最大脂肪球尺寸。
blocks.en: Detection range setting: lower limit 1.8 µm, upper limit 50 µm: The 1.8 µm lower limit is below the 5 µm target threshold so that particles near 5 µm are also reliably detected; the 50 µm upper limit covers the largest fat globule size that could be clinically harmful.

blocks.zh: 計數精度要求 ±10%：與 〈788〉 對注射劑微粒計數的精度要求一致——這是光遮蔽法在計數應用上的標準驗收準則。
blocks.en: Counting accuracy requirement of ±10%: This is consistent with the accuracy requirement of <788> for particle counting in injectables, and is the standard acceptance criterion for light obscuration in counting applications.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 執行 〈729〉 Method II 時，稀釋方案（dilution scheme）的開發是方法驗證中最關鍵的步驟之一。不同脂肪濃度（10%、20%、30% TPN 乳劑）需要不同的稀釋倍數才能達到符合限值以下。在常規放行測試中，稀釋方案必須標準化並記錄在 SOP 中——方法驗證報告中必須包含稀釋線性性的驗證資料（dilution linearity study）。
blocks.en: When a CDMO performs <729> Method II, developing the dilution scheme is one of the most critical steps of method validation. Different fat concentrations (10%, 20%, 30% TPN emulsions) need different dilution factors to get below the coincidence limit. For routine release testing, the dilution scheme must be standardized and documented in an SOP, and the method validation report must include dilution linearity study data.

blocks.zh: Method II — Procedure, Interpretation & PFAT5 Acceptance Criteria | 程序、解讀與 PFAT5 接受標準
blocks.en: Method II: Procedure, Interpretation & PFAT5 Acceptance Criteria

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula — PFAT5
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation: PFAT5

blocks.zh:
PFAT5 計算公式（體積加權）：

PFAT5 (%) =
  [Σ(Ni × Vi) for Di > 5 µm]
  ─────────────────────────── × 100%
  [Σ(Ni × Vi) for ALL channels]

Where:
  Ni = number of globules per mL in channel i
  Vi = volume of a sphere of geometric mean
       diameter of channel i
     = π × Di³ / 6

Di = geometric mean diameter of channel i

Acceptance criterion: PFAT5 ≤ 0.05%
Instruments: HIAC Royco, PSS AccuSizer, Klotz

Key insight: Even if >5 µm globules are numerically
rare (e.g., 0.01% by count), their large volume means
they can constitute a significant % of total fat mass.
Volume weighting makes this calculation clinically
relevant.
blocks.en:
PFAT5 calculation formula (volume-weighted):

PFAT5 (%) =
  [Σ(Ni × Vi) for Di > 5 µm]
  ─────────────────────────── × 100%
  [Σ(Ni × Vi) for ALL channels]

Where:
  Ni = number of globules per mL in channel i
  Vi = volume of a sphere of geometric mean
       diameter of channel i
     = π × Di³ / 6

Di = geometric mean diameter of channel i

Acceptance criterion: PFAT5 ≤ 0.05%
Instruments: HIAC Royco, PSS AccuSizer, Klotz

Key insight: Even if >5 µm globules are numerically
rare (e.g., 0.01% by count), their large volume means
they can constitute a significant % of total fat mass.
Volume weighting makes this calculation clinically
relevant.

blocks.zh: PFAT5 ≤ 0.05% 是什麼概念？換算成直覺的數字：在 100 mL 的脂肪乳劑中，所有直徑大於 5 µm 的脂肪球體積總和，不能超過 0.05 mL（50 µL）。這個限度由美國靜脈輸注護理學會（ASHP/ASPEN）根據靜脈輸注安全研究確立，已被 USP 正式採納。
blocks.en: What does PFAT5 ≤ 0.05% mean? In intuitive numbers: in 100 mL of fat emulsion, the total volume of all fat globules larger than 5 µm in diameter must not exceed 0.05 mL (50 µL). This limit was established on the basis of intravenous infusion safety research by ASHP/ASPEN (the American Society of Parenteral and Enteral Nutrition and related bodies) and has been formally adopted by USP.

blocks.zh: Volume-Weighted vs. Number-Weighted（體積加權 vs. 數量加權）：選擇體積加權計算 PFAT5，是因為肺部損傷的機制與大脂肪球的體積（即實際脂肪量）直接相關，而不僅僅是個數。一個 20 µm 的大球，其體積相當於 64 個 5 µm 球（體積 ∝ 直徑³）——用數量加權會嚴重低估風險。
blocks.en: Volume-Weighted vs. Number-Weighted: PFAT5 is calculated on a volume-weighted basis because the mechanism of lung injury is directly related to the volume of the large fat globules (that is, the actual amount of fat), not just their number. One 20 µm globule has the volume of 64 globules of 5 µm (volume ∝ diameter³), so number weighting would seriously underestimate the risk.

blocks.zh: 「至少兩次採樣間 >5 µm 球數差兩倍」的要求：這是一個統計充分性（statistical adequacy）要求，確保計數到足夠數量的大粒子，使 PFAT5 計算結果具有統計代表性。如果採樣次數不足，即使每次結果都符合 ≤ 0.05%，也可能因計數不足而缺乏可靠性。
blocks.en: The requirement that the >5 µm globule counts differ by no more than a factor of two between at least two samplings: This is a statistical adequacy requirement, ensuring that enough large particles are counted for the PFAT5 result to be statistically representative. If too few samplings are made, the result may lack reliability because of insufficient counts, even if every individual result meets ≤ 0.05%.

blocks.zh: PVC/DEHP 容器禁忌：USP 在腳注中特別提醒，PVC 含 DEHP（鄰苯二甲酸二乙基己酯）的管路已被證實會破壞脂肪乳劑的乳化穩定性——實驗室樣品準備時必須使用 Type I 玻璃容器，避免 DEHP 造成假陽性（PFAT5 偏高）。
blocks.en: PVC/DEHP container prohibition: In a footnote, USP specifically warns that PVC tubing containing DEHP (di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate) has been shown to destroy the emulsion stability of fat emulsions. Type I glass containers must be used when preparing laboratory samples, to avoid false positives (falsely high PFAT5) caused by DEHP.

blocks.zh: 某脂肪乳劑批次 PFAT5 = 0.04%（符合標準），但發現一個 30 µm 的超大脂肪球。USP 〈729〉 的計算方式能否捕捉到這種異常？這個批次應該放行嗎？
blocks.en: A fat emulsion batch has PFAT5 = 0.04% (within the criterion), but one very large 30 µm fat globule is found. Can the USP <729> calculation capture this kind of anomaly? Should this batch be released?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Method II 的系統適用性要求使用 5 µm 和 10 µm 標準品，而不是像 Method I 那樣使用更小的標準品（100–400 nm）？這反映了兩種方法在技術上的什麼差異？
blocks.en: Why does the system suitability requirement for Method II use 5 µm and 10 µm standards, rather than smaller standards (100–400 nm) as in Method I? What does this reflect about the technical differences between the two methods?

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 打算將同一台 HIAC Royco 儀器同時用於 USP 〈788〉（注射劑微粒）和 USP 〈729〉（脂肪乳劑 PFAT5）的測試。這在技術上可行嗎？需要注意哪些方法轉移（method transfer）的要點？
blocks.en: A CDMO plans to use the same HIAC Royco instrument for both USP <788> (particulate matter in injections) and USP <729> (PFAT5 of fat emulsions). Is this technically feasible? What method transfer points need attention?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 製造 TPN（全靜脈營養液）或脂質奈米粒（Lipid Nanoparticles, LNP）的場景中，PFAT5 的監測策略應整合到製程驗證（Process Validation）與持續製程確認（Continued Process Verification, CPV）中。監控趨勢圖（trending chart）可以在 PFAT5 尚未超出 ≤ 0.05% 標準時，就提前偵測到製程漂移（process drift），為 CAPA 提供更多提前量。LNP 疫苗製造（如 mRNA 脂質奈米粒）雖然原始粒徑更小（約 80–120 nm），但若乳化失控也可能產生超大聚集體，〈729〉的監控原則同樣具有參考價值。
blocks.en: In CDMO manufacture of TPN (total parenteral nutrition) or lipid nanoparticles (LNP), the PFAT5 monitoring strategy should be integrated into process validation and continued process verification (CPV). A trending chart can detect process drift early, before PFAT5 exceeds the ≤ 0.05% criterion, giving CAPA more lead time. LNP vaccine manufacture (such as mRNA lipid nanoparticles) starts with a much smaller particle size (about 80–120 nm), but uncontrolled emulsification can also produce oversized aggregates, so the monitoring principles of <729> remain a useful reference.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Method I（DLS）接受標準：MDD < 500 nm；系統適用性 CV ≤ 15%；χ² 值須在儀器規格內
blocks.en: Method I (DLS) acceptance criteria: MDD < 500 nm; system suitability CV ≤ 15%; χ² value within the instrument specification

blocks.zh: Method II（LE/SPOS）接受標準：PFAT5 ≤ 0.05%（體積加權，>5 µm 脂肪球佔總分散相比例）
blocks.en: Method II (LE/SPOS) acceptance criterion: PFAT5 ≤ 0.05% (volume-weighted; proportion of the total dispersed phase in globules >5 µm)

blocks.zh: PFAT5 計算公式為體積加權（∝ Di³）的原因：反映大粒子的臨床安全風險比數量加權更準確
blocks.en: PFAT5 is calculated on a volume-weighted basis (∝ Di³) because this reflects the clinical safety risk of large particles more accurately than number weighting

blocks.zh: 兩種方法均需通過 NIST 可追溯標準品的系統適用性驗證，方可進行樣品分析
blocks.en: Both methods must pass system suitability verification with NIST-traceable standards before samples can be analyzed

blocks.zh: 交叉參考：〈429〉（LD）、〈788〉（注射劑微粒）；樣品製備避免 PVC/DEHP 容器
blocks.en: Cross-references: <429> (LD), <788> (particulate matter in injections); avoid PVC/DEHP containers in sample preparation
